build_wavenet_model: build a WaveNet model with configurable blocks, layers, kernel size, and channel dimensions for audio generation
create_causal_conv1d: create a CausalConv1d layer that applies causal padding to prevent future information leakage in sequence modeling
create_wavenet_layer: create a WavenetLayer with dilated causal convolution, gate-output activation, residual and skip connections
export_layer_weights: export all dilated, residual, and skip convolution weights and biases from trained WaveNet layers
export_final_weights: export the final skip conv, fully connected, and logits layer weights and biases from the WaveNet model
